### 2. Cluster Profile Definitions: Household-Sovereignty Modes

**Profile P-JKHC — Japan & Korea High-Honorific / Command-Avoidance / Elder-Authority / High Privacy-Anxiety Cluster**
*Representative Corridor: High-context, high-technology-trust markets where always-listening stigma is severe, direct command is socially abrasive, and elder authority governs household technology adoption.*
- **Interaction-Trust Covenant**: Direct elder-council / family-head correlation; indirect-request grammar mandatory; engineering-council mediation required for IP/tooling split.
- **Hidden-Western-Dependency Exposure**: Critical hidden direct-grammar dependency (English imperative NLP core masked by polite TTS output); hidden individual-account architecture (no elder-gate / family-role layer); hidden legal-notice-only privacy model (no symbolic/ritual disconnection mechanism).
- **Engineering-Culture Correlation**: High resistance to “translated direct-command” product; organizational manager-diaspora networks can spread collective elder-rejection across markets rapidly; requires direct-site technical-council covenant.
- **Market-Instrument Profile**: Milestone-gated cluster certification; formal elder-council / family-authority covenant; integrated local-processing node for sensitive queries; physical mute/shutter hardware mandatory.
- **Stakeholder Communication**: Direct elder-council + engineering-board transparency portal emphasizing hidden-dependency disclosure.

**Profile P-THMG — Thailand Multigenerational / Social-Fluid / Family-Unit / Moderate Honorific Cluster**
*Representative Corridor: Extended-family households with fluid social hierarchy, strong hospitality norms, Buddhist-calendar integration, and family-unit (not individual) privacy expectations.*
- **Interaction-Trust Covenant**: Family-unit intermediary-trust; elder-respect embedded but less rigid grammatical hierarchy than P-JKHC; caregiver/relative role integration expected.
- **Hidden-Western-Dependency Exposure**: High hidden nuclear-family assumption (single “owner” profile inadequate); hidden direct-grammar comfort gap (moderate but present); hidden individual-data ownership (family wants collective or elder-controlled logs).
- **Engineering-Culture Correlation**: Moderate direct feasibility; high cross-contamination risk from Western “personal assistant” narrative; requires family-unit transition protocol with hospitality-mode design.
- **Market-Instrument Profile**: Family-unit site-license with multigenerational role architecture; caregiver-access mode; guest-privacy mode; Buddhist/religious-event feature gate.
- **Stakeholder Communication**: Family-head + religious/community-intermediary + transparency portal.

**Profile P-GULF — Gulf Multigenerational / Gender-Structured / Religious-Modesty / Status-Oriented / Arabic-Dialect Cluster**
*Representative Corridor: Multigenerational households with gender-role segmentation, religious-modesty privacy requirements, status-display technology adoption, and dialect-diverse Arabic interaction.*
- **Interaction-Trust Covenant**: Gender-authority / religious-intermediary-trust dominates; male elder authority for household settings; female users require private/confidential interaction channels; servant/caregiver role access.
- **Hidden-Western-Dependency Exposure**: Critical hidden gender-neutral design (voice gender, profile naming, data-display); hidden religious-blind scheduling/privacy; hidden MSA-only language model (dialect failure); hidden nuclear/individual-account architecture.
- **Engineering-Culture Correlation**: Low direct feasibility without gender-mode separation; high offense risk from cross-gender data exposure or prayer-time interruption; requires gender-interface covenant and religious-privacy audit.
- **Market-Instrument Profile**: Gender-segregated mode covenant with voice-selection; elder-male admin gate; female private mode with encrypted local storage; prayer-time automatic disable; status-display feature integration.
- **Stakeholder Communication**: Religious-privacy board + gender-authority board + family-council transparency portal.

**A. The Dual-Corridor Verification Gate (B1 → B2)**

No market achieves **B2 (Qualified)** status without completing both corridors simultaneously:

- **Corridor A — Technical / Regulatory / Commercial**: Honorific-grammar engine certified (indirect-request morphology, not direct overlay); dialect/acoustic model verified; gender-mode separation engineered; multigenerational role-account architecture built; privacy-UX hardware integrated; government-access / regulatory covenant executed.
- **Corridor B — Cultural / Dependency / Behavioral**: **Hidden-Western-Design-Dependency Map** completed—every feature tagged with direct-grammar dependency %, individual-account dependency %, nuclear-family assumption %, cloud-only dependency %, gender-neutral design residue %; **household-authority mapping** verified with local elder-council / family-head / gender-authority ethnographic covenant (not market-survey-only); **privacy-ritual verification** (physical mute/shutter tested with local users in multigenerational settings; local-processing node confirmed for sensitive categories); **cross-contamination firewall** activated—global marketing/managers spreading “personal assistant / direct command” narrative mapped and neutralized via direct local-technical-council covenant; **elder-authority correlation agreement** and **gender-interface audit** signed by local household-authority representatives.

*Strategic implication*: A Japan-release with polished Japanese TTS but unverified direct-grammar NLP core and no elder-gate architecture remains **B1 only**—pilot feature-release permitted at capped capacity, but no strategic feature migration (B3) until Corridor B closes.

**B. The Commitment-Component Registry Separation**

Every regional adaptation agreement must be disaggregated—not merged into a “Japan/Thailand/Gulf localization memo”:

- **Migration Investment**: Actual capital to reach B2 (honorific-engine R&D, dialect acoustic training, multigenerational-account architecture build, privacy-hardware design, elder-council transition, gender-mode engineering, local-data-center build).
- **Local Trust Reservation**: Risk capital held in reserve—not spent—covering elder-boycott response, gender-offense remediation, privacy-backlash regulatory suspension, hidden-dependency crisis, and cross-market organizational contamination.
- **Group Feature Capacity Commitment**: What global core promises to maintain: **Base unified standard delivery** (global NLP/cloud for non-sensitive features; universal security updates) + **Swing/Protection** (regional local-processing nodes, crisis-switch capacity for privacy/regulatory shock, feature-gate suspension funding sourced from global-core profit retention).
- **Pilot Launch Quarter**: Defined quarter-window for B1→B2 transition; feature-release capped at pre-agreed % of total portfolio; every interaction event geo-traced.

*Strategic implication*: Do not commit a “full Gulf feature rollout” in a gender-mode-covenant until Migration Investment and Local

### 2. Cluster Profile Definitions: Household-Sovereignty Modes

**Profile P-JKHC — Japan & Korea High-Honorific / Command-Avoidance / Elder-Authority / High Privacy-Anxiety Cluster**
*Representative Corridor: High-context, high-technology-trust markets where always-listening stigma is severe, direct command is socially abrasive, and elder authority governs household technology adoption.*
